mapper.select: SELECT v.config::text FROM nw_platform_models m JOIN nw_platform_model_versions v ON v.model_id=m.id AND v.revision=m.current_revision ORDER BY m.id

SELECT id::text AS id, draft->>'name' AS name, draft->>'kind' AS kind, draft->>'provider_id' AS provider_id, draft->>'model_id' AS model_id, (draft->>'enabled')::boolean AS enabled, current_revision AS published_revision, draft_changed AS has_unpublished_changes FROM nw_platform_models ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM nw_platform_models ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM nw_platform_models WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_models(id,current_revision,draft_revision,draft,draft_changed,time_pricing_rule_id) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),NULL,1,CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),TRUE,#{ruleId})
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_platform_models SET draft=CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),time_pricing_rule_id=#{ruleId},draft_revision=draft_revision+1,draft_changed=TRUE WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND draft_revision=#{expected}
UPDATE nw_platform_models SET draft=jsonb_set(draft,'{compatibility_report}',CAST(#{report} AS jsonb),TRUE) WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND draft_revision=#{expected}

UPDATE nw_platform_models SET current_revision=#{revision},draft_changed=FALSE WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND draft_revision=#{expected} AND draft_changed=TRUE AND (current_revision IS NULL OR current_revision=#{revision}-1)
mapper.select: SELECT v.config::text FROM nw_platform_models m JOIN nw_platform_model_versions v ON v.model_id=m.id AND v.revision=m.current_revision WHERE m.id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
SELECT config::text FROM nw_platform_model_versions WHERE model_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT config::text FROM nw_platform_model_versions WHERE model_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) ORDER BY revision DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_platform_model_versions(model_id,revision,config,actor_id,time_pricing_rule_id) VALUES(CAST(#{id} AS bigint),#{revision},CAST(#{config} AS jsonb),#{actor},#{ruleId})
mapper.select: SELECT time_pricing_rule_id FROM nw_platform_models WHERE id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint)
SELECT time_pricing_rule_id FROM nw_platform_model_versions WHERE model_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT id::text AS model_id,draft_revision AS revision,time_pricing_rule_id AS rule_id FROM nw_platform_models WHERE time_pricing_rule_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
SELECT model_id::text,revision,time_pricing_rule_id AS rule_id FROM nw_platform_model_versions WHERE model_id=CAST(#{id} AS bigint) AND time_pricing_rule_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY revision
SELECT llm_model_config_id::text,embedding_model_config_id::text,rerank_model_config_id::text FROM nw_tenant_model_selections WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_tenant_model_selections(tenant_id,llm_model_config_id,embedding_model_config_id,rerank_model_config_id) VALUES(CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint),CAST(#{s.llmModelConfigId} AS bigint),CAST(#{s.embeddingModelConfigId} AS bigint),CAST(#{s.rerankModelConfigId} AS bigint)) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id) DO UPDATE SET llm_model_config_id=EXCLUDED.llm_model_config_id,embedding_model_config_id=EXCLUDED.embedding_model_config_id,rerank_model_config_id=EXCLUDED.rerank_model_config_id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_agents WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND id=CAST(#{agent} AS bigint))
SELECT model_config_id::text FROM nw_agents WHERE tenant_id=CAST(#{tenant} AS bigint) AND id=CAST(#{agent} AS bigint)
